(efonidipine) Profile Efonidipine is a dihydropyridine calcium-channel blocker with general properties similar to those of nifedipine (p.1350). It is used as the hydrochloride in the treatment of hypertension. ◊ References. 1. Tanaka H, Shigenobu K. Efonidipine hydrochloride: a dual blocker of L- and T-type Ca channels.
